subject.title: fix(doctor): bound AGENTS.md and root-memory file reads

question: Should `openclaw doctor --fix` deliberately stop root-memory repair without mutation whenever either file exceeds the hardcoded 8 MiB limit, leaving split-brain memory for manual operator repair?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive change to a shipped durable-memory migration: the safe resource bound is valuable, but the threshold and manual-repair outcome determine whether previously repairable workspaces remain automatically recoverable.

options.title: Approve bounded no-mutation repair
options.body: Keep the 8 MiB limit and require doctor to preserve both files, clearly report the skipped repair, and direct the operator to a safe manual recovery path.

options.title: Revise the migration boundary
options.body: Choose a different bounded strategy or threshold that still prevents runaway allocation while retaining an approved automatic repair path for larger legitimate memory files.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded no-mutation repair
recommendation.body: Keep the 8 MiB limit and require doctor to preserve both files, clearly report the skipped repair, and direct the operator to a safe manual recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the root-memory split-brain repair and are the strongest history-backed owner for its migration semantics.
